start.headline: The visit is where families decide.
start.body: Here's how a parent books a campus visit on their own, and how Banner Connect makes sure they actually show up.

steps.alt: The Schedule a Visit booking page with November dates available
steps.title: Parents pick a day that works
steps.body: Your booking page shows only the times you're available. No back-and-forth emails to find a slot.

steps.alt: The booking page with 10:00 AM on Thursday, November 5 selected
steps.title: Then a time
steps.body: Sarah picks 10:00 AM on Thursday. The visit is blocked on your calendar the moment she confirms.

steps.alt: The booking details form filled in by Sarah Ramirez with a note about her son starting 2nd grade
steps.title: A few details and she's booked
steps.body: She adds a note for your team. It goes straight onto her record, so whoever gives the tour knows what to expect.

steps.alt: The Request a Visit workflow: confirmation email, then reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before the visit
steps.title: Reminders go out on their own
steps.body: A confirmation right away, a reminder the day before, and another an hour before. Fewer families forget.

steps.alt: The workflow branches for visit attended, no-show with reschedule email, and not a fit
steps.title: After the visit, one click from your team
steps.body: Your staff marks how it went. Attended moves the family forward. A no-show gets a friendly reschedule email automatically.

finish.headline: Booked, reminded and followed up, all without a phone call.
finish.body: Your team spends its time on the visit itself, not on scheduling it.
